specification.authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
references: §20.4.41, pp. 144-146: 3DSOLID/REGION ACIS body and R2007+ History ID H field
specification.limit: §20.4.41 names the History ID H field but does not specify the complete proprietary ACIS history graph or establish its DXF owner-code mapping.

implementation.change: DRW_ModelerGeometry now retains the encoded history H handle, including raw role code and 64-bit value, plus the exact parser handle-stream bit span and source revision. Reset clears all appended evidence. A private production helper handles exact absence, full H fields and partial/truncated bounds; the opt-in physical probe emits the captured values.
implementation.semanticPolicy: Capture is diagnostic only. It does not translate DWG hard ownership to DXF group 350, validate a recursive target graph, or enable strict output.

remaining: Keep the selected AC1027 source profile output-ineligible: ACSH_HISTORY_CLASS direct fields are complete, but its graph targets ACSH_SWEEP_CLASS, whose class-specific action body is incomplete and has no AC1027 writer route.

Resolve the DWG hard-owner code 3 to DXF group-350 soft-owner projection only through an authoritative rule or independent producer evidence that establishes role and remapping semantics; the observed converter output alone is insufficient.
Advance to another locally implementable P4/P6 source-backed gap; do not repeat graph discovery, parser-helper controls, or unchanged converter launches.
Keep strict whole-source conversion refused until source graph closure and the complete 3D output route pass their separate gates.

outputRouteAudit.readerCapture: For successfully typed ACSH_* DWG objects, makeRawObject stores tmpByteStr (the complete decompressed object body from DwgObjectFrame::body) with source class/common-link metadata; dx_iface retains bounded AcSH/evaluation-graph frames in acdsHistoryDwgFrames.
outputRouteAudit.ac1027WriterRoute: The AC1027+ DataStorage route selects collectAcdsTypedBoxHistoryObjects when typed history/evaluation objects exist. This route emits ACSH_HISTORY_CLASS and ACSH_BOX_CLASS only; its selected profile requires an ACSH_BOX_CLASS target. The pinned graph instead targets ACSH_SWEEP_CLASS. That class's EvalExpr and HistoryNode prefixes parse, but its embedded sweep/path entity blobs and SweepOptions action-body tail remain partial/best-effort; LibreDWG 0.14 leaves 2568 bits unknown for this object and is not a semantic oracle. The AC1024 opaque-proxy collector is explicitly AC1024-only.
outputRouteAudit.rawDxfRoute: rawAcdsHistoryObjects is populated by the DXF AcShHistory import path, where original DXF group sequences exist. It does not convert a DWG-encoded object body into equivalent DXF fields.
outputRouteAudit.entityAssociation: The 3DSOLID DXF writer remaps/resolves the history target and emits group 350. Source H code 3 is identified by ODA as hard ownership, while Autodesk DXF docs call group 350 soft-owner; converter output corroborates the value only.
outputRouteAudit.disposition: No lossless AC1027 DWG-to-DXF route is established for the selected Sweep history graph: there is no ACSH_SWEEP_CLASS writer, its class-specific action-body tail is incomplete, and the DWG H code-3 to DXF group-350 role projection is unqualified. Do not serialize retained DWG body bytes as a DXF proxy or synthesize missing fields. Keep the selected source profile output-ineligible and strict output refused.
